instructions:
1. Kneel with your right knee on the floor and left foot flat in front, knee over ankle.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
3. Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep your torso upright.
4. Press both dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
5. Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your ribs down and core braced so your lower back does not arch.
2. Squeeze the down-side glute to stabilize the split stance.
3. Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows through the press.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Use a neutral grip, palms facing your torso, arms hanging at your sides.
3. Curl the right dumbbell up toward your shoulder, keeping your elbow tucked.
4. Lower it under control until your arm is fully extended.
5. Repeat with the left arm, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows pinned to your sides; do not swing the weight.
2. Hold a firm neutral wrist throughout the curl.
3. Keep your back straight and core braced to prevent leaning.
4. Control the lowering phase rather than dropping the weight.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Use a neutral grip, palms facing your torso, arms hanging at your sides.
3. Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders at the same time, elbows tucked.
4. Squeeze at the top of the movement.
5. Lower both dumbbells under control until your arms are fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows pinned to your sides; do not swing the weights.
2. Hold a firm neutral wrist throughout the curl.
3. Keep your back straight and core braced to prevent leaning.
4. Control the lowering phase rather than dropping the weights.

instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees and lie face down with your chest on the pad.
2. Plant your feet on the floor and hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, palms facing each other.
3. Let your arms hang straight down with a slight bend in the elbows.
4. Pull the dumbbells to your torso, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Lower the dumbbells under control to full extension.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest pressed to the pad; do not push up to cheat the weight.
2. Lead with your elbows and squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
3. Exhale as you pull, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your neck neutral and gaze down at the pad.

instructions:
1. Sit at a preacher bench with your chest against the pad and feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, palms facing each other, upper arms on the pad.
3. Extend your arms fully but keep a slight bend to hold tension.
4. Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms on the pad.
5. Lower both dumbbells under control to near-full extension.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms flat on the pad to isolate the elbow flexors.
2. Do not let the dumbbells drop; control the lowering phase.
3. Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep a firm neutral wrist throughout.
